f.pu: The goals of creating the Reserve are: 1. preservation in the natural state of the seaside complex of wetlands on the eastern coast of the Kamchatka Peninsula, represented by a shallow estuary formed at the confluence of the Zhupanov River into the Kronotsky Bay, as a habitat for waterfowl, semiaqu…
f.re: On the territory of the Reserve, economic and other activities are prohibited that entail a change in the historically established natural landscape, a decrease or destruction of the ecological, aesthetic and recreational qualities of the territory of the Reserve, violation of the regime for its protection and the use of unique natural complexes and objects, including: 1. any activity that entails violation, damage,…
